items.title: Dave S. Oxley Sr. Interview, 1965-01-06
items.q: My daddy used to buy the records of Celestine and King Oliver and those fellas, you know.

ctx.x: Had you wanted to play in a band then or were you with some other kids that needed a drummer? How come you started on drums?

Well, I'll tell you. We had one of those old graphophones, you know, the graphophones with a big horn, you know. My daddy used to buy the records of Celestine and King Oliver and those fellas, you know.
I remember those old records, yeah.
